body.prompt: Instrumental percussion only, 88 BPM, 4/4. A soft, steady, suspenseful pulse for a secret vote at night: a muted woodblock ticking on every beat like an old clock, quiet closed hi-hat in eighth notes, a soft shaker. No pitched instruments, no melody, no chords, no bass, no fills, no build-up, no ending, the same throughout so it can loop seamlessly.
